subject: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries

Team —

We need a quick heatcheck on where we stand for HelixBank's combined FedRAMP/ISO intake next month. The external auditor (Sara) asked for a short summary of evidence boundaries and who will own each artifact before we open the portal. My goal is a 10–15 minute packet we can hand to the auditor this week so they can scope sampling.

Please confirm the following by EOD Thursday:
- Control owner for encryption and KMS evidence (key manifests, rotation logs).
- Snapshot window(s) we can commit to for log exports (app + infra).
- Short list of anything we know is out-of-scope for HelixBank (e.g., partner-managed data flows).
- Which SIG/CAIQ attachments we can seed into the portal immediately.

I attached an initial evidence_map_v1.xlsx — it is intentionally sparse. Olga, can you fill control owners? David, can you confirm snapshot cadence and whether we can pull a 30-day app log bundle? Grace, flag any regulatory carve-outs.

We need a single upload link for Sara (ideally the portal). If portal not ready, plan B is a scp to our SFTP and create a portal ticket.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-03T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries

Markus —

I've added a first pass to control_owners.csv and marked strong candidates for each control. A few notes:
- Key manifest: Security will own the canonical manifest, but the cloud team (David) will produce rotation logs and key metadata export.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can seed CAIQ v2 (attached) and include narratives for physical controls that are vendor-managed.
- Out-of-scope: any third-party analytics pipeline managed by PartnerX is out-of-scope; we'll flag in the evidence map so auditors don't request samples.

I'll upload the CSV to the drive folder and leave comments where I need confirmation.

Attachment: control_owners.csv

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Sr. InfoSec Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: david.kim@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-04T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries

Quick answers from infra:
- Snapshot window: we can provide a 7-day rolling snapshot by default; for sampling we can generate arbitrary point-in-time snapshots back to 90 days, but that requires a compute job and a small cost for extraction. For HelixBank we should commit to either 30-day or 90-day snapshots — recommend 30-day to keep extract time reasonable.
- App logs: 30-day export of application logs (structured) is available; retention is 90 days in hot storage and 365 days in cold storage.
- KMS: we can produce kms_key_manifest.txt and rotation audit trails; rotation events are in CloudAudit logs. Note: there is a scheduled key rotation on 2028-08-15 for one test key — I'll exclude test keys from the manifest unless we want to include them.

If auditors need daily rolling exports, we should budget a small extraction window. I'll prepare a short runbook for the portal upload.

—David
David Kim
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeaudit.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: tim.byrne@helixbank.com, portal@acmeaudit.com
Date: 2028-08-06T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries

Hi Markus / Team —

Thanks for the heads-up and the early materials. A few requests from the audit side to make our sampling and scheduling deterministic:
1) Please confirm the final evidence_map and control owners by 2028-08-09 so we can lock sample sizes.
2) For KMS evidence: we need the full manifest plus rotation logs covering the previous 180 days where available. If you can only provide 90 days, indicate that as a variance.
3) Snapshot timing: confirm whether you will commit to a 30-day or 90-day point-in-time extract for the audit window.
4) Portal upload: please upload CAIQ and CAIQ narratives (sig_caiq_v2.pdf) plus the evidence_map to our portal at the link below. Use ticket ID RED-1134 when uploading.

Portal upload link: https://acmeaudit.portal/upload/RED-1134
Preferred format: zip of artifacts, CSV manifests, and any runbooks referenced.

If HelixBank has any specific regional requirements (e.g., data residency for a subset of controls), please highlight now so we can route the workpaper reviewers.

Regards,
Sara Lewis
Lead Auditor — ACME Audit Services

Attachment referenced: sig_caiq_v2.pdf
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acmeaudit.com>, tim.byrne@helixbank.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-09T17:40:00Z
Subject: Re: FedRAMP / ISO readiness: stakeholder heatcheck & evidence boundaries

Sara / Tim —

Thanks — consolidating and committing below so we can close the loop before portal upload:
- Evidence map & control owners: final file uploaded to Drive and portal seed (evidence_map_v1.xlsx + control_owners.csv). Owner confirmations are in the CSV comments. (See Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Compliance-Package)
- KMS manifest & rotation logs: David will provide a 90-day rotation export immediately and a petition for 180-day export (we can produce but needs a scheduled extraction; ETA 8/14 if HelixBank agrees to the extraction window). File: kms_key_manifest.txt attached to portal upload.
- Snapshot commitment: we will commit to a 30-day point-in-time extract for the initial sampling; if auditors require 90-day, we will coordinate a run to produce it (extra work).
- CAIQ / SIG: seeding sig_caiq_v2.pdf now; we will add narratives for controls marked as vendor-managed.
- Out-of-scope: PartnerX analytics pipeline flagged in the evidence map; auditors should exclude it from sample requests.

Action items assigned:
- Olga: finalize control owner confirmations by 2028-08-10.
- David: upload 90-day KMS rotation bundle to portal (or SFTP) and start 180-day extraction request if HelixBank signs off.
- Grace: confirm any HelixBank regional carve-outs (data residency) by 8/10.
- Markus: seed portal with current CAIQ and evidence_map; then create RED-1134 ticket in Jira linking artifacts.

Attachments uploaded to portal: evidence_map_v1.xlsx, control_owners.csv, kms_key_manifest.txt, sig_caiq_v2.pdf

I'll follow up with a short meeting if Sara needs a walkthrough. Thanks everyone.

—Markus
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
